classes.invariant: Every member is a day name and every member is consonant-initial, so the three frames the libraries actually use -- 'on X', 'since X', 'next X' -- stay well formed under every swap, and the one 'a Saturday' site takes any of the seven. No day name appears in any signal lexicon, so no swap can move a signal term. What a swap does move is the implied duration of 'since X', and that is safe here only because no signal in this dataset is scored on duration: fever_present, dysuria_present and the rest are all point-in-time presence, and recent_uti_present keys on 'weeks ago' and 'this month' rather than on a day name. Checked against fever_null_thirdparty 'My carer who visits twice a week has had a fever since X'.
